findings: AbortError is converted to NETWORK_ERROR by the web API client.
Initial bootstrap failure can hydrate an empty state; refresh failure does not consistently lock writes.
LAST SYNC uses latest audit event time instead of successful bootstrap time.
mustChangePassword is returned but not enforced by API business routes or the web UI.
Local v5 migration entry is visible to operators although API requires manager/admin.
Bootstrap only returns current-day audit events, so cross-day object history and removed/sold module history are incomplete.
rationale: 契约字段与主要响应形状匹配，但以上生产边界会导致误导状态、权限噪声或审计历史缺失，必须在完成 05-web-api 前修复。
